description:

Item: Wheel Assembly, Pneumatic Tire
NSN: 2530-01-506-7648
Part Number: M1062WHEELSS
Inspection/Acceptance Points: Origin/Origin    FOB Point: Destination

This Wheel and Tire Assembly is competitive and has Technical Data Packages (TDP) that contains purchased parts. Please see TDP for additional information.
